newsitem.title: DUBAI: Dubai gold imports rise in July - WGC.
newsitem.headline: Dubai gold imports rise in July - WGC.

text.p: The Gulf gold trading centre of Dubai imported 29,890 kg of gold in July, up from 26,334 kg in the same month last year, the World Gold Council (WGC) said.
This lifted total gold imports to Dubai to 199,165 kg in the first seven months of the year, up from 189,019 kg in the January to July 1995 period.
July imports were higher than the 28,392 kg imported in June.
Dubai is the main feeder market into India, which is the world's single largest gold consuming market, with about 80 percent of Dubai's gold imports destined for the Indian subcontinent.
The WGC said the main suppliers of gold to Dubai in July were Switzerland, with 22,331 kg, Britain, with 6,451 kg and South Africa, with 575 kg.
The WGC is a non-profit association owned by the world's major gold producers and monitors about 80 percent of the world's markets.
